verdict.rationale: Llama is a model family and platform with an official ecosystem (CLI, docs, partner hosting), so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack contains no mention of an MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. Function calling and the 'multi-agent coding' tagline are adjacent features, not an MCP server, and the probes found no machine-readable API surface (llms.txt and OpenAPI both 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
